name: Tablić
description: Tablić (or Tablanette) is a fishing-style card game popular in the Balkans (Serbia, Croatia, Bosnia). Players capture face-up cards from the table by matching their value or summing to their value. Points are awarded for capturing specific high-value cards (face cards, 10s, Aces) and for having the most cards. The game is similar to Casino.

history.origins: Derived from the Casino family of fishing games; widely played in the former Yugoslavia.
timeline: 20th century: Popular across former Yugoslavia; rules published in English (Phillips & Westall 1939).
history.cultural: A classic pastime in Balkan countries, often played by children and adults.

setup.players: Normally two players, or four in fixed partnerships with partners sitting opposite. A three-player game is also possible but less usual; in Serbia deal and play are counter-clockwise.
setup.dealing: Dealer deals 6 cards to each player and 4 face up on the table. Only the first deal places cards on the table. Subsequent deals refill hands until the deck is exhausted.

rules.objective: Score points by capturing cards. Scores: A, K, Q, J, 10 = 1 point. 10 of Diamonds (Double Ten) = 2 points. 2 of Clubs (Little Two) = 1 point. Most cards = 3 points. Tabla (clearing the table) = 1 point.
rules.gameplay: Players play one card from hand. If it matches a card on table (by rank) or a sum of cards (e.g. 9 captures 9, or 5+4), the player captures them. If no capture, the card stays on table. The player who makes the last capture takes any remaining cards at the end.

strategy.basic: Capture as many point cards as possible (10, J, Q, K, A, 2♣). Prioritize the 10♦ (2 points). Try to clear the table (Tabla) for bonus points.
strategy.intermediate: Do not leave cards on the table that sum to easily captured numbers (like 11-14) if opponents likely hold face cards. Save high cards to make large captures.
strategy.advanced: Track the 10♦ and 2♣. Calculate remaining points. In endgame, try to make the last capture to sweep the board.
tips: Kings (14), Queens (13), Jacks (12) can capture sums.
Clearing the table is worth a point (Tabla) - except at the very end.
